t: You're looking at Holy Trinity, Sloane Street, a Church of England parish church with a striking Arts and Crafts design. It was built between 1888 and 1890 by the architect John Dando Sedding, and it was paid for by the fifth Earl Cadogan, on whose London estate it stands. It replaced an earlier church only half its size, which was less than sixty years old when it came down. Sedding was an influential figure in the Arts and Crafts movement, and many leading designers studied in his offices. The colonial judge Peter Benson Maxwell is buried here.
